title: Downgrading ISP
snippet: I recently moved and went from AT&T fiber 1000/1000 to Xfinity cable 1000/35. The hit to upload speeds I fear is going to kill my homelab functionality. I run Immich, Darawich, Nextcloud, Plex, *Arr apps + QT, Vaultwarden, Linkwarden. Most of this is on Unraid with some of it on a couple proxmox servers. I also have a VPS in hostinger with my website, nginx proxy manager, and tailscale end node. My question is what is a good way to measure my outbound usage. I'm not a networking engineer by trade and only knowledgable enough to get things setup. I wish I asked this before I moved but hindsight is 20/20 when moving in a rush. I would like to gauge how fucked I am in all of the services I am using and if I can/should offload them to the vps.   submitted by   /u/johnfredone [link] &#3
